message.content: On June 26, 2026, LiHua and ChaeSong-hwa had a conversation centered around the successful completion of their research study and the upcoming celebration they planned to hold after their jam session. In this exchange, ChaeSong-hwa expressed his excitement about the breakthrough in their research and the anticipation for sharing more details with LiHua. He also suggested celebrating soon, possibly after their next jam session, which included plans for a fun night with snacks and drinks. LiHua agreed enthusiastically, indicating her excitement for the celebration and looking forward to enjoying some relaxation and conversation with ChaeSong-hwa.
